top_concerns: Claims of surpassing GPT-5 rest on a 0.008 gap with no CIs, and an asymmetric K=4 ensemble vs single-pass proprietary baselines
Circular downstream evaluation: reward and metric share the GPT-4.1/VIEScore rubric; no human eval or reward-hacking check
Causal claim that a high-fidelity RM is the key to RL is weakly supported: no teacher-as-reward baseline, single-run RL, no seeds; Table 4 shows equal accuracy giving different RL outcomes
Possible data overlap between RM training/benchmark and GEdit/ImgEdit used for RL evaluation; pairwise accuracy definition unclear (ties, below-chance 0.325)
Modest novelty and thin comparison with other editing reward models; data filtering not ablated
